The response at a few distances from the center of the spectrum, for D_0 = 0.2 and W = 0.1 and order 2. With order 2 the Butterworth filter changes smoothly, and the band-reject response is 0 at D_0. The band-pass response is 1 minus the band-reject response. In the zone plate of the figure, distance r from its center has frequency r / 160, so D = 0.1 lies 16 pixels from the center.
